extraction_notes: Digitised main-text performance figures visually from the supplied page images. Figure 8 and Figure 9 report MeOH formation rate in mol h−1 (mol catalyst metal)−1 versus temperature at ambient pressure; common activity conditions from Experimental section 2.2 are 0.1 g catalyst, feed N2:H2:CO2 = 6.75:2.25:1 (H2:CO2 = 3:1), total flow 20 mL/min, and space velocity approximately 4000 h−1. For Figure 12a stability, only first and last plotted points were digitised as instructed; temperatures are the labels printed beside each series. Duplicate catalyst/temperature points appearing separately in Figures 8 and 9 were retained as plotted figure data. Figure 10 was skipped because it plots equilibrium/experimental constants rather than conversion, selectivity, or MeOH formation/STY. Figure 11 was skipped because it is CO/H2 hydrocarbon production (not CO2 hydrogenation to methanol performance and not CH4 selectivity). Figures 13–17 are DRIFTS/characterisation and were skipped.
